Question 6
?

Calculate P+Q, where

P=[1−1−40−12],Q=[2−3112−4].

a
[2−1−311−2]
b
[3−4−111−3]
c
[3−4011−2]
d
[3−4−311−2]
e
[3−4−313−6]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We add the corresponding entries:

P+Q=[1−1−40−12]+[2−3112−4]=[1+2(−1)+(−3)(−4)+10+1(−1)+22+(−4)]=[3−4−311−2]
